messages:
alex.chen: Hey team — heads up: NovaHealth has a live demo POC next Wed 10:00–12:00 PT and they want a short throughput window. Can we provision a temporary hosted QPS bump and an ephemeral scoped key? Expected pattern: bursts up to ~180 rps for ~20m, avg ~30 rps. No PHI will be sent, it's synthetic. Who can own?

morgan.li: Thanks — quick q's: which endpoints will they hit (chat vs embeddings vs batch)? Also which model size are they testing and do they need streaming? Any IP restrictions from their side?

alex.chen: They'll hit chat completions (/v1/chat/completions) with streaming on. Model plan: redwood-1.1 (or fallback to redwood-1-small). Customer will provide static office IPs for allowlist.

jamie.patel: I can prepare the demo script and run a local load run. For fidelity we'll mimic 600-token responses and streaming, spike pattern: 3x 6m bursts inside the 2h window. Confirming no real PHI — just synthetic names.

ops-bot: FYI current hosted soft QPS per org = 50 qps. For demo spikes we support temporary increases but need a ticket and mitigations: scoped ephemeral key, IP allowlist, 2h window, and monitoring. Please request via https://redwood.support/tickets with subject: "POC temporary qps increase - NovaHealth".

priya.security: Good that it's synthetic. For approval we still need: scoped key limited to chat scope, log retention policy set to 30 days, and confirmation that no raw user PHI is stored. Also request an executed DPA for production later, but not needed for demo.

morgan.li: Suggestions for resilience: configure client-side retries for 429, set a fallback policy to redwood-1-small (lower token counts) if we hit sustained throttles, and cap max_tokens to 1024 during the demo to limit long-tail token cost.

alex.chen: Jamie — can you share the load script and a target IP allowlist to hand to ops? Ops, can you provision an ephemeral scoped key with a 200 qps provisional limit for a 2-hour window (bump from 50 -> 200) while ticket is reviewed? We'll monitor.

jamie.patel: I'll post the load script Monday morning. Example request we'll use:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ephemeral-demo-XXXX" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize patient case"}],"max_tokens":600, "stream": true}'
```

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026. Provisional increase set to 200 qps from 2026-05-06T17:00:00Z to 2026-05-06T19:00:00Z pending review. Please supply IP allowlist and name for the scoped key. We will monitor error rate and revert if 429+ errors > 2% or latency exceeds SLO.

alex.chen: Perfect — I'll get the IPs and key name to you by EOD Friday. Thanks all. :rocket:

jamie.patel: I'll run an internal smoke/load test Monday 09:00 PT and paste results here.

priya.security: I'll review logs retention settings once the key is created. If anything looks off we'll pause the window.

alex.chen: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround.
